name: posterior fusion of lumbosacral vertebrae-blepharoptosis syndrome
description: Posterior fusion of lumbosacral vertebrae-blepharoptosis syndrome is characterized by congenital ptosis and posterior fusion of the lumbosacral vertebrae. It has been described in a mother and her two daughters.
